How to earn points & AI credits
Every verified bug report and merged pull request triggers an automatic email notification with your updated points, AI credits, and leaderboard rank.
Report a reproducible bug in Hanzo Dev, Cloud, Console, or SDKs. Earn +50 bounty points and up to $20 in AI credits.
Ship a merged pull request fixing an open GitHub issue labelled bounty. Earn +100 to +500 points and AI credits.
Invite a builder who activates a paid plan or trial. Earn +20 leaderboard points and $5 in AI credits.
Every 100,000 tokens processed across Hanzo Cloud models automatically adds +1 point to your global standing.
